CustomField.label: Cron Expression
CustomField.description: Raw Salesforce CRON expression used when Schedule Type is Cron (e.g. "0 0 2 * * ?"). For Daily/Weekly/Monthly this field holds the expression generated from the other schedule fields.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Seconds Minutes Hours Day_of_month Month Day_of_week, e.g. 0 0 2 * * ?
